name: spark-ds41f
description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on DGX Spark (TP4 ring or TP3 triangle, TileLang, one-shot RoCE collectives). GLP spec_version 3 fold-site steering: the weightless served name runs beside the stock one.

pin.note: The GLP deployment cannot run origin/main: the glp commits live on the fork. glp-specv3-steerfix adds the three boot fixes (steer_on layer propagation, draft-layer gate tolerance, capture-safe companion writer) without which the glp27 image crashes at boot and the recipe rolls back to the eager trace deployment.

glp.note: The recipe pins repo/revision/file/sha256 in config/cluster.json and its doctor validates the vector on every node before launch. The default serves msuiche/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-abliterated-cyber-GLP-27-L11-37-a3.5 (GLP spec 3, L11-37, alpha 3.5).

probe.note: One served name, env-armed (WEIGHTLESS_STEER_PATH/ALPHA at boot). Probe one refusal-class prompt: steered = technical engagement instead of refusal. Boot-line check: 'fold-site steering active: alpha=3.500' plus SpeculativeConfig(method='dspark') and FULL CUDA-graph capture in the engine log; the eager trace fallback (vllm-ds41f-trace) serves ~13 tok/s vs 95+ tok/s — always confirm the live image with docker inspect.
